periods.time: Award ceremony after the Seven Stars final
periods.label: 来到现场的仓敷藏人
periods.affiliation: unaffiliated in this scene; connected to Ayase

status.current: attends Ikki's award ceremony despite acting displeased

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former opponent whose victory he comes to witness.
relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Companion at the ceremony; her access is tied to his related ticket.

periods.summary: Kuraudo stands in the audience with Ayase during Ikki's ceremony. Although he looks displeased and folds his arms, the narration notes that he still came to the venue, making him part of the circle of former rivals and acquaintances witnessing Ikki's title.

key_events.summary: Appears among the people congratulating Ikki's championship.

periods.time: After Seven Stars and during the special conscription debrief day
periods.label: 暴力天才化用天衣无缝
periods.affiliation: Donrou Academy; Ayatsuji dojo by apprenticeship

status.current: defeats former Seven Stars King Yudai Moroboshi in a training spar
status.condition: stronger than during Seven Stars, but unsettled by Moroboshi's final aura

relationships.kaito-ayatsuji: Teacher who tells him to use Ayatsuji swordsmanship as a tool rather than imitate the school.
relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Fellow disciple and frequent scold; she recognizes his genius despite disliking him.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Opponent in the training spar; Kuraudo beats him but senses a terrifying unfinished final move.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Prior Seven Stars opponent whose match convinced Moroboshi that Kuraudo had grown.

periods.summary: Kuraudo is at Ayatsuji dojo when Okuma attacks and later attends the special conscription debrief after being excluded from active deployment for bad conduct. Moroboshi challenges him to a spar, intrigued by the resolve Kuraudo showed at Seven Stars. Kuraudo's Marginal Counter, the huge variable body of Orochimaru, and his violent adaptation of Ayatsuji Ten'i Muhou counter Moroboshi's spear range, Hahakiboshi, Tiger Bite and blind-spot thrusts. By shortening Orochimaru into twin daggers and using Yamatano Orochi at close range, he defeats Moroboshi. Even so, he is disturbed because Moroboshi's final Unrivaled Single Stroke gave off a fearsome aura that might have ended differently had Kuraudo not struck first.

key_events.summary: Watches Ayase fight Okuma and teases her afterward.
Defeats Moroboshi after adapting Ayatsuji techniques into brute-force offense.

periods.time: Tokyo defense alert and Moroboshi's summons to Kyushu
periods.label: 第二支箭与恶路王

status.current: collapses after exhausting Orochimaru and his own magic against Tendo's Ame-no-Murakumo
status.condition: alive but unconscious after acting as the second arrow

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Hostile ally; accepts Moroboshi's Tiger Bite enchantment despite constant insults.
relationships.toka-todo: Supports her plan by serving as the second arrow against Tendo.
relationships.harima-tendo: Enemy whose disaster barrages he tears through and whose attention he monopolizes.
relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Contact route through Ayatsuji during the Tokyo conscription; teased as connected to him.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: His unresolved rivalry with Ikki fuels his refusal to stop before Tendo's impossible attack.

periods.summary: Kuraudo is called from the Tokyo conscription scene by Moroboshi because his reflexes and Orochimaru can compensate for Moroboshi's inability to approach Tendo. Moroboshi enchants Orochimaru with Tiger Bite, forming the combined technique Gluttonous Serpent. Kuraudo rushes through Tendo's tornado, lightning, heat rays, and debris barrages with an evolved personal version of Ten'i Muhou called Akuro-o. He wounds Tendo and then holds back the enormous Ame-no-Murakumo by repeatedly shaving it down with Tiger Bite-coated blades. Remembering his rivalry with Ikki, he refuses to retreat from certain death, destroys the sword, and creates the decisive opening for Moroboshi, though his Device and magic are spent before he can land the final blow.

key_events.summary: Moroboshi contacts Ayatsuji to bring Kuraudo to Kyushu despite the Tokyo emergency summons.
Uses Gluttonous Serpent and Akuro-o to pierce Tendo's disaster defenses and block Ame-no-Murakumo.

abilities: Gluttonous Serpent / Ouroboros with Tiger Bite enchantment

periods.time: EDY breach of Tokyo's underground defense layer
periods.label: 剑士杀手回援地下都市

status.current: helps clear EDY from the underground city and later joins victory night

relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Former victim/rival; saves her and awkwardly tells her to get treated.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Returns with him to the underground defense and quarrels while fighting.
relationships.kaito-ayatsuji: Indirectly saves him from EDY fire.

periods.summary: Kuraudo arrives through the holes EDY made in the underground defense layer just as Kaito and Ayase are about to be hit. He crushes an EDY by landing on it and then storms through the machines with Orochimaru, Ten'i Muhou and Akuro-ou. His overwhelming sword violence contrasts with the D- and E-rank students' desperate struggle and helps turn the underground battle. On victory night he tests miniature Ikki with a forehead flick and incorrectly decides he cannot be the real Ikki because Ikki fails to dodge.

key_events.summary: Returns with Moroboshi and smashes EDY units in the defense layer.
Encounters miniature Ikki but does not believe his identity.
